item.title: Lafayette Nominated for USA Today’s Best Place to Visit for Fall
item.description: Lafayette has been nominated for Best Place to Visit for Fall in USA Today's 10Best Readers' Choice Awards. Over the next four weeks, the public can vote for their favorite destination once per day until voting closes on Monday, September 8, at 10:59 a.m.

item.title: Lafayette Travel Releases Second Episode of “Gumbo People” Featuring Muralist Robert Dafford
item.description: Lafayette Travel has released the second episode of its original video series Gumbo People, which highlights the artists, culture bearers, and professionals who help shape the parish’s cultural identity. The latest episode spotlights internationally renowned muralist Robert Dafford, whose work has transformed public spaces across Louisiana and beyond.

item.title: Call for Nominations: Allons Awards 2025
item.description: Lafayette Travel invites the community to submit nominations for the second annual Allons Awards, which honor the outstanding achievements within Lafayette Parish's hospitality industry.

item.title: Lafayette Travel Releases Third Episode of “Gumbo People” Featuring Michelle “Malentina” Colon
item.description: Colon, a multi-talented performer, producer, and cultural advocate whose work has enlivened Lafayette’s creative scene for years. Known for her bold stage presence and performances, Colon blends music, theater, and visual storytelling in ways that challenge convention while celebrating the Latin community. Her Gumbo People feature reflects on the role of performance in shaping identity, her passion for empowering artists, and her belief in Lafayette as a place where creative expression thrives.

item.title: Lafayette to Host International Food Wine and Travel Writers Annual Conference
item.description: Lafayette Travel is proud to host the International Food, Wine, & Travel Writers Association (IFWTWA) Convention to Lafayette, Louisiana, October 12-15, 2025. The convention will bring esteemed travel writers from across the country for an immersive experience in the heart of Cajun and Creole country.

item.title: Lafayette Travel Releases Third Episode of “Gumbo People” Featuring Photographer Ben Peirce
item.description: Lafayette Travel has released the latest episode of its original video series Gumbo People, which highlights the artists, culture bearers, and professionals who help shape the parish’s cultural identity. Through cinematic portraits of local creatives, the series explores how generations of cultural influences have shaped Lafayette’s music, art, food, and traditions.

item.title: Lafayette to Host 2026 LHSAA State Golf Championships
item.description: The Lafayette Convention & Visitors Commission (LCVC) is proud to announce that Lafayette will once again serve as host city for the 2026 Louisiana High School Athletic Association (LHSAA) State Golf Championships, continuing a tradition that has made Acadiana a premier destination for high school championship events for more than a decade.

item.title: Lafayette to Host 2026 USATF National Junior Olympic Cross Country Championships at Moncus Park
item.description: Lafayette Parish will welcome the nation’s top young distance runners in December 2026 as USA Track & Field (USATF) selects Moncus Park as the host site for the 2026 USATF National Junior Olympic Cross Country Championships. The championship will take place on December 12, 2026, bringing qualifying athletes ages 7–18 from across the United States to compete for national titles.
